Granite Point Capital Management Lp increased its stake in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc (MRNS) by 379.78% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Granite Point Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $189.25M market cap company. The stock increased 1.08% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $4.67. About 348,376 shares traded. Marinus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNS) has risen 73.49% since December 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 57.87% the S&P500.
